questions.question: How does David describe himself in Psalm 86?
What does David ask God to teach him?
options: His law, so that he may keep its commands
His way, so that he may walk in his truth
His will, so that he may do his pleasure
His name, so that he may praise it forever
questions.answer: His way, so that he may walk in his truth

questions.question: David asks God to unite his heart to fear his name.
